dedupe_keys.name: popis rjesenja o ukidanju odobrenja za stavljanje lijeka u promet

description: Popis rješenja o ukidanju odobrenja za stavljanje lijeka u promet is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agencija za lijekove i medicinske proizvode RH. The list of decisions to revoke marketing authorisations includes data on medicinal products for which marketing authorisations were revoked in the period from 2009. The list is maintained and regularly updated by the Agency for Medicinal Products and Medical Devices (HALMED). Coverage: Agencija za lijekove i medicinske proizvode RH. The portal shows the English title as "List of decisions revoking the marketing authorisation" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agencija za lijekove i medicinske proizvode RH. Its keywords include Ljudsko zdravlje i sigurnost, lijekovi. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
